_note: Coin shop timings, in seconds unless the key says otherwise; distances in 1920x1080 pixels, angles in degrees. A wave is amp * sin(2 pi * hz * t + phase_rad). A wobble is amp * e^(-decay * a) * sin(rad_per_s * a), for dur_s after its event (a = time since it).

coins._note: The till rolling down to the new amount after a purchase.

talk._note: When the keeper speaks up: about the listing in focus once it stayed there browse_after_s (at most every browse_gap_s), and after a silence of first_idle_s, then idle_repeat_s.

entrance._note: The listings pop in this long after the page shows.

page._note: The page floats (the sum of the waves of each axis, rot in degrees) and its shadow follows shadow_follow of it. A reroll turns it (shuffle); a sold-out slam shakes it, delay_s after the purchase.

listing._note: Each listing sways (its tilt by sway_rot_deg, its place by sway_x_px / sway_y_px) at a rate picked in sway_hz's [min, max]; selected, it eases in at select_rate_per_s, rises select_lift_px and grows by select_grow.

pop._note: The listings pop onto the page stagger_s apart, each turned by up to spin_deg (random), growing from start_scale with an outBack(overshoot) over ease_s, fading in over fade_s; dur_s ends the pop.

select_wobble._note: Degrees, when it gets the focus.

poor._note: Pixels sideways, when out of reach.

sold_out._note: Pixels sideways, when tried while sold out.

plate._note: A title plate shows delay_s after its listing popped in, fading in over fade_s.

stamp._note: The sold-out stamp slams down over slam_s from 1 + slam_grow times its size (fading in over fade_s), then wobbles in scale until settle_end_s; tried again, it shakes (degrees).

burst._note: The featured burst rocks by sway_deg every period_s.

sticker._note: The featured price sticker rocks by sway_deg every period_s.

marker._note: The selection marker grows from start_scale with an outBack(overshoot) over grow_s, fades in over fade_s and rocks by sway_deg every period_s.

keeper._note: The keeper breathes (scale amp every period_s). Its bubble types chars_per_s letters a second and stays hold_s plus hold_per_char_s a letter; a low-priority line waits low_gap_s after the last one finished typing.

hop._note: The keeper hops when its expression changes (calla: Calla's hop amount), and nods (nod_factor of it) when it keeps it. Squash over squash_s (scale 1 + squash_x, 1 - squash_y), rise over rise_s (scale 1 - stretch_x, 1 + stretch_y, height_px up), settle over settle_s (settle_wobbles half-turns, scale 1 + settle_x, 1 - settle_y); all times the amount.

bubble._note: The speech bubble pops over pop_s from start_scale (outBack(overshoot)), fading in over fade_s; a new line while open boings it (boing_grow over boing_s); it closes over close_s, shrinking by close_shrink. It floats float_px every float_period_s.
